senses.gloss:
€1Ā. (चेष्टते, चेष्टित) 
__1 To move about, stir, be active, show signs of life; यदा स देवो जागर्ति तदेदं चेष्टते जगत् [[Ms. 1. 52]]; [[Māl. 8. 8]]; [[Ś. 6. 27.]] 
__2 To make effort, endeavour, exert oneself, struggle. 
__3 To perform, do (anything). 
__4 To frequent. 
__5 To behave, act. With वि 
__1 to stir, move, be in motion, move about. 
__2 to act, behave.

a. [चेष्ट्-ण्वुल्] Making efforts. 
-कः A particular mode of sexual enjoyment or coitus.

[चेष्ट्-अङ्] 
__1 Motion, movement; संरुद्धचेष्टस्य [[R. 2. 43]]; किमस्माकं खामिचेष्टानिरूपणेन [[H. 3]]; [[Māl. 5. 7.]] 
__2 Gesture, action; चेष्टया भाषणेन च नेत्रवक्त्रविकारैश्च लक्ष्यतेऽ न्तर्गतं मनः [[Ms. 8. 26.]] 
__3 Effort, exertion. 
__4 Behaviour [[Pt. 1. 150.]] 
__5 Action, deed, performing. 
-नाशः destruction of the world. 
-निरूपणम् observing a person's movements.

p. p. [चेष्ट्-कर्तरि क्त] Moved, stirred &c. 
-तम् 
__1 Motion, gesture, act. 
__2 Doing, action, behaviour; कपोलपाटलादेशि बभूव रघुचेष्टितम् [[R. 4. 68]]; तत्तत्कामस्य चेष्टितम् [[Ms. 2. 4]] doing or work.
